integrity: The critical polynomial identities were replayed from the packaged exact-arithmetic checker. Literature comparisons distinguish material actually read from inaccessible or abstract-only sources.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the canonical Sprott C system and compactly supported invariant probability measures, not to the entire generalized Sprott C or Sprott BC parameter families.
It gives necessary stationary and crossing constraints but does not classify all compact invariant measures or prove existence of a physical chaotic measure.
The closest 2012 Nonlinear Dynamics article was available only at abstract/metadata level; institutional retrieval required interactive human input.
The separate 2012 Wei–Pehlivan full PDF was read in extracted text around the system definition, equivalence statement, dynamical results, and conclusion; a page-render attempt timed out.
Targeted database searches cannot exclude differently phrased or unindexed older stationary identities.
title: Heightwise unit-amplitude law and a sharp cylinder-crossing obstruction in the Sprott C flow
